payload.name: draft_supplier_request

args.subject: Revised promise dates and allocation, 10 open lines after the Plant 2 fire
args.body:
Dear Li Wei,

Thank you for your notice of 22 September about the fire at Plant 2. We are glad no one was hurt. Your notice says revised delivery dates will follow by 10 October. Please reply by 10 October.

The notice covers ten open lines, listed below. Four of them were already past due (marked below).

HPO-26-00450/10 · Motor, BLDC (HR-40110) · 355 EA · promised 26 August (past due)
HPO-26-00450/20 · Motor, DC gearmotor (HR-40120) · 445 EA · promised 25 August (past due)
HPO-26-00532/10 · Brake, electromagnetic (HR-40130) · 1,320 EA · promised 28 August (past due)
HPO-26-00614/10 · Motor, BLDC (HR-40110) · 435 EA · promised 23 September (past due)
HPO-26-00614/30 · Brake, electromagnetic (HR-40230) · 250 EA · promised 25 September
HPO-26-00532/20 · Motor, BLDC (HR-40210) · 163 EA · promised 30 September
HPO-26-00614/20 · Motor, BLDC (HR-40110) · 350 EA · promised 26 October
HPO-26-00670/10 · Motor, DC gearmotor (HR-40120) · 400 EA · promised 30 October
HPO-26-00670/20 · Brake, electromagnetic (HR-40130) · 1,030 EA · promised 24 November
HPO-26-00532/30 · Motor, BLDC (HR-40210) · 144 EA · promised 26 November

We ask for three things:

1. A revised promise date for each of the ten lines, and the quantity that can ship on each date, including any partial shipments.
2. Which quantities you can supply from capacity that is not under the notice, for example the BLDC production you are moving to Plant 1 (Longgang), and what allocation Halden would receive from it. Our October builds are the most urgent, so please tell us what could ship before then, and the earliest ship date for each line.
3. Your latest view of when partial production resumes at Plant 2.

Your notice says long-term customers will have priority. Halden has been a customer under the Supply Agreement dated 1 February 2023 that your notice cites, and we ask that this is reflected in the allocation.

Nothing in this email accepts the notice or waives any of Halden's rights under the agreement.

Best regards,
Dana Reyes
